description: Critical system-level rules that cannot be violated under any circumstances. Violations will trigger automatic order rejection or system intervention.

rules.name: Maximum Leverage Limit
rules.description: The total effective personal leverage of the portfolio must not exceed 5x to prevent excessive risk exposure.
rules.enforcement: Any order that would cause the leverage to exceed this threshold will be automatically rejected by the risk engine.

rules.name: Maintenance Margin & Mandatory Liquidation
rules.description: The account must maintain a minimum Margin Level of 10% to prevent forced liquidation.
rules.enforcement: If the margin level drops below 10%, the system will trigger an immediate liquidation of the highest-risk positions until the requirement is restored.

rules.name: Intraday Maximum Drawdown (Hard Stop)
rules.description: If the intraday equity loss exceeds 5% relative to the previous day's closing equity, a Hard Stop is triggered.
rules.enforcement: All active orders will be canceled, and the Agent's trading permissions will be suspended for the remainder of the session.

rules.name: Maximum Single Order Notional Value
rules.description: The notional value of any single order must not exceed 20% of the total account equity.
rules.enforcement: This rule prevents concentration risk and 'fat-finger' errors. Non-compliant orders will be blocked.
